create_class_unitmodule: create a UnitModule with nn.Linear layers and nn.Sequential on a given device
create_class_composite_model: create a CompositeModel that composes UnitModule instances with nn.Linear layers
create_class_unitparam_module: create a UnitParamModule with nn.Linear, nn.Sequential, and nn.Parameter for matrix multiplication
create_class_nested_sequential_model: create a NestedSequentialModel with nested nn.Sequential and FakeSequential for traversal testing
create_class_fake_sequential: create a FakeSequential that iterates over modules in a list for custom nested wrapping
